caption:
Global Metadata: A lonely, vast wordless hum, 60 BPM, E minor, a desolate spacious instrumental evoking an empty vast landscape. Emotional arc: isolation and wistfulness, a lone figure under enormous empty sky, bittersweet, quiet ache, ending unresolved in the distance. Production: very wide, distant, echoey, sparse, lots of air and reverb.

Vocal Details: A single voice only, an adult female soprano humming wordlessly, a thin, fragile, ethereal 'mm' and 'ooh', solitary and far away, like calling across an empty valley with no answer. Slightly trembling, wistful, alone.

Arrangement: Intro, a lone distant piano note and an open droning pad, vast emptiness. Body, the fragile female hum floats alone over a sparse piano note and a distant sustained synth, echoing, no rhythm, no company. Ending, the hum trails off into a long silence, unresolved and alone.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Distant piano, empty vast

[Body]
mm... ooh... mm...
ooh... mm... ooh...

[End]
a long silence, alone
